en: A colorized vintage postcard image depicting a classical building labeled 'Schauspielhaus' in a leafy park setting, with a statue bust on a pedestal in the foreground and people walking around. The style and people's clothing suggest an early 20th-century setting. The reverse shows typical postcard formatting, German script 'Postkarte,' and a museum stamp referencing Bad Pyrmont.
